title: Odile and the Archive
author: Yara Lockridge
blurb: Casper Montrose, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
